description: Agent Legal: submit an assignment record with the agreement’s assignment clause: the record with the agreement, the assignor, the assignee, what the assignee is to the assignor, each right or obligation assigned, whether it covers the whole agreement, the day it takes effect and each consent it shows with the party and the day given; the clause with the agreement, each party, its rule (prohibited, consent_required or permitted), each party whose consent it requires, each kind of assignee it excepts, each assignee it allows, each right it allows to be assigned and whether the whole agreement may be assigned. The signed report gives the record and the clause, the rule with any exception that applies, each consent the clause requires against the consents shown, the assignee against the assignees allowed, and the rights assigned against the rights the clause allows, and counts them, and names a divergent assignment: an assignment the clause prohibits, a required consent the record does not show and an assignee or scope unlike what the clause allows; then an assignor the agreement does not name, a consent dated after the assignment takes effect and another agreement name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No rule, exceptions with no assignee kind, a consent requirement with no consenting party or no consents listed, limited assignees with no assignee named, or limited rights with none stated leaves the assignment unverified. Parties and assignees read as parties without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, kinds, exceptions and rights by their words with plurals folded, the consenting parties are those the clause names or else the parties other than the assignor, and dates read as days. Verdict legal_assignment_divergent, legal_assignment_partial, legal_assignment_unverified or legal_assignment_consistent. POST /api/legal-assignment-check. Reads the contract records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never drafts, negotiates, signs or files anything, judges no fairness of terms and no readiness of a deal to settle, and leaves enforceability, interpretation and legal advice to lawyers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Legal reads contract records across the agreement lifecycle for consistency between documents: an executed agreement, a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, an execution record, a renewal or termination notice, the exhibits attached to an agreement and an assignment record, each against the term sheet or deal summary, the master agreement, the pricing terms and the quote, the agreement it amends, the signature requirements, the notice clause, the exhibits the agreement references or the assignment clause it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral and compares different documents with each other, not versions of one document. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-legal-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-legal/.
